title: Rename `environment` → `stages` and enable array syntax for betterado_release_definition
essence: The `betterado_release_definition` resource now uses `stages = [{ ... }]` array syntax instead of `environment { }` block syntax. The misleading `environment` key (which models pipeline stages, not infra environments) is renamed to `stages`, and `ConfigMode: SchemaConfigModeAttr` is applied to `stages`, `deploy_phase`, `artifact`, `variable`, and `retention_policy` — enabling HCL `for`/`concat` expressions and a more readable, consistent configuration style. This is a breaking schema change with no back-compat alias.

checkpoints.label: Schema key rename — `environment` → `stages`
checkpoints.caption: The provider schema no longer exposes `environment`; users must use `stages`
checkpoints.beforeNote: resource_release_definition.go line ~115 had `"environment": { TypeList, ... }`; expand/flatten helpers named `expandEnvironments`, `flattenEnvironments`; every `d.Get`/`d.Set`/`d.GetOk` call used `"environment"`.
checkpoints.afterNote: Schema map key is `"stages"`; helpers are `expandStages`/`flattenStages`; all call sites updated. Sub-field keys (`environment_options`, `environment_trigger`, `definition_environment_id`) are unchanged — they are ADO API sub-field names.

checkpoints.label: ConfigModeAttr applied to list/set collections
checkpoints.caption: Five schema entries now carry `ConfigMode: schema.SchemaConfigModeAttr`, enabling `= [{ ... }]` assignment syntax
checkpoints.beforeNote: All nested block collections used the default `SchemaConfigModeAuto`; users had to write `stages { }` / `deploy_phase { }` / `artifact { }` etc. as separate HCL blocks — incompatible with `for`/`concat` expressions.
checkpoints.afterNote: `stages`, `deploy_phase` (within a stage), `artifact` (top-level), `variable` (top and stage-level), and `retention_policy` (MaxItems:1 within a stage) all carry `ConfigMode: schema.SchemaConfigModeAttr`. Terraform now accepts `stages = [{ ... }]` and the full HCL dynamic-expression surface.

checkpoints.label: Acceptance tests converted + new TestAccReleaseDefinition_stagesArraySyntax added
checkpoints.caption: All existing TestAccReleaseDefinition_* HCL fixtures converted from `environment { }` to `stages = [{ }]`; new array-syntax acceptance test added
checkpoints.beforeNote: All ~30 acceptance-test HCL fixture functions used `environment { }` block syntax; attribute paths checked via `resource.TestCheckResourceAttr` used `environment.0.*`; `TestAccReleaseDefinition_stagesArraySyntax` did not exist.
checkpoints.afterNote: All HCL fixtures in `resource_release_definition_test.go` converted to `stages = [{ }]`; `TestCheckResourceAttr` paths updated to `stages.0.*`; `TestAccReleaseDefinition_stagesArraySyntax` added exercising two-stage config with `retention_policy`, `deploy_phase`, and `ExpectNonEmptyPlan: false`. TF_ACC tests require live ADO credentials — unit gate covers schema correctness; acc test is wired and will run in CI with credentials.

checkpoints.beforeNote: Both files used `environment { }` block syntax in all HCL examples; the attribute reference table listed `environment` as the key.
checkpoints.afterNote: Both files use `stages = [{ }]` array syntax; `artifact = [{ }]` array syntax; `retention_policy = { }` single-object syntax; terrafmt-clean. The attribute reference table lists `stages`.
